stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Gilgamesh tells the other Eternals that Odin himself taught him a secret brew recipe, as thanks after they helped defeat Laufey's army at Tønsberg. It is only told, never shown.
stages.whoA: King of Asgard. He taught Gilgamesh a secret brew as thanks.
stages.whoB: An Eternal who helped Asgard beat Laufey's army. Odin taught him a brew.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Kingo says Thor used to follow him around when he was a little kid. Now Thor is a famous Avenger who, Kingo jokes, won't return his calls. It is only told, never shown.
stages.whoA: Thor. He followed Kingo around as a boy, and now won't return his calls.
stages.whoB: Kingo, an Eternal. Thor followed him around as a little kid, Kingo says.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: After the Rum Punch Massacre, Ridley tells Misty that Bulletin reporter Karen Page just called her for a quote, asking about a living witness the police are keeping quiet. Ridley then faces the press over Karen's story. The call itself is only told.
stages.whoA: Karen Page. A Bulletin reporter who calls her about the massacre's secret witness.
stages.whoB: Priscilla Ridley. The deputy police chief she calls for a quote about a witness.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Joy shows Ward blackmail dirt on the Rand board, gathered by the private investigator she hired a while ago, Jessica Jones. Joy says she was worth every penny when she was sober. Jessica herself never appears.
stages.whoA: Jessica Jones. The private eye she hired to dig up dirt on the Rand board.
stages.whoB: Joy Meachum. A client who hired her to dig up dirt on the Rand board.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: During Koenig's lie detector screening, it comes out that Garrett would get a call from Alexander Pierce once in a while, and that he said they had mutual friends. The calls are only mentioned, never shown.
stages.whoA: Alexander Pierce. He calls Garrett now and then; they share mutual friends.
stages.whoB: John Garrett. An agent he calls now and then; they share mutual friends.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: A close look at May's phone shows Natasha Romanoff saved among her contacts, a hint that the two S.H.I.E.L.D. agents know each other. Nothing more is said or shown.
stages.whoA: Natasha Romanoff. Saved in May's phone contacts.
stages.whoB: Melinda May. A fellow S.H.I.E.L.D. agent with Natasha's number in her phone.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: A close look at May's phone shows Jimmy Woo saved among her contacts, a hint that the two know each other. Nothing more is said or shown.
stages.whoA: Jimmy Woo. Saved in May's phone contacts.
stages.whoB: Melinda May. A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent with Jimmy's number in her phone.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Coulson tells Steve that Banner was one of many trying to recreate the serum used on him, thinking gamma radiation might hold the key to Erskine's original formula. It did not go his way, and that work made him the Hulk. Banner and Erskine never meet.
stages.whoA: Dr. Abraham Erskine. Bruce tried to recreate his formula and became the Hulk.
stages.whoB: Bruce Banner. Trying to recreate Erskine's formula with gamma made him the Hulk.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Zola tells Steve that when history did not cooperate, Hydra changed it. As he says accidents will happen, a news clipping of the Starks' fatal car crash appears on his screens, hinting that Hydra had Maria and Howard Stark killed. It is only hinted, never shown.
stages.whoA: Maria Stark. Zola hints Hydra arranged the car crash that killed her.
stages.whoB: Arnim Zola. His Hydra arranged the car crash that killed her and Howard.

stages.title: The Consultant
stages.text: Coulson tells Sitwell the World Security Council wants Blonsky, the Abomination, exonerated, released and added to the Avengers roster, which Fury does not want. Coulson arranges to sabotage the request and later reports that Blonsky will stay in his cage. They never meet.
stages.whoA: Emil Blonsky, the Abomination. Coulson works to keep him caged.
stages.whoB: Phil Coulson. The S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who makes sure Blonsky stays in his cage.

stages.title: The Consultant
stages.text: When Coulson says the Council wants Blonsky on the Avengers team, Sitwell helps him plot to sabotage it, even offering to play the patsy who makes General Ross refuse to release him. They never meet.
stages.whoA: Emil Blonsky, the Abomination. Sitwell helps plot to keep him caged.
stages.whoB: Jasper Sitwell. A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who plots to keep Blonsky locked up.

stages.title: Black Widow (Post-Credits Scene)
stages.text: At Natasha's grave, Valentina hands Yelena her next target, Clint Barton, and claims he is the man responsible for her sister's death. She sends Yelena after him without ever facing him herself.
stages.whoA: Clint Barton. She tells Yelena he killed Natasha and sends her after him.
stages.whoB: Valentina Allegra de Fontaine. She sends Yelena to kill him, blaming him for Natasha.

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Wenwu tells Katy that some years ago an American terrorist stole the legend of his Ten Rings and, not knowing his real name, invented the Mandarin for his figurehead. He never names Killian, and they never meet.
stages.whoA: Aldrich Killian. He stole Wenwu's Ten Rings legend for his fake Mandarin.
stages.whoB: Wenwu. The real Ten Rings leader, whose legend he stole for the Mandarin.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: As the new Captain America, Walker tells Good Morning America that he followed Steve Rogers' career closely and modeled his work after him. They never met, but Walker says Steve feels like a brother.
stages.whoA: Steve Rogers. His hero. They never met, but Walker now carries his shield.
stages.whoB: John Walker. The new Captain America, who modeled himself on Steve.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Nagel boasts that by recreating the super soldier serum he did what no other scientist since Erskine was able to do, and that his version would be different. It is only told; they never meet.
stages.whoA: Dr. Abraham Erskine. Nagel boasts he is the first since Erskine to make the serum.
stages.whoB: Wilfred Nagel. He recreates Erskine's serum and boasts of matching him.

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: In 1997, young Gravik is among the Skrull refugees when Fury promises that he and Carol Danvers will find them a new home, a promise never kept. Later Gravik leads the team that collects the Avengers' blood, hers included, for the Harvest, and takes her powers. They never meet.
stages.whoA: Carol Danvers. She and Fury promised his people a home that never came.
stages.whoB: Gravik. A Skrull she and Fury promised a home. He later takes her powers.

stages.title: Ironheart
stages.text: Ezekiel tells Riri that the plane crash story about his father is a lie: his dad died trying to kill Tony Stark. He says he has spent his whole life trying to be nothing like him. He and Tony never meet.
stages.whoA: Tony Stark. Zeke's dad died trying to kill him.
stages.whoB: Ezekiel Stane. Obadiah's son, who wants nothing of his father's war on Tony.

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: Going through Stark's old records, the AIs learn that Tony based each of them on a real person, and J.A.R.V.I.S. on Edwin Jarvis, the Stark family butler. In Vision's mind, J.A.R.V.I.S. wears Edwin's face. The two never meet.
stages.whoA: Edwin Jarvis. The Stark family butler Tony modeled him on.
stages.whoB: J.A.R.V.I.S. Tony's AI, named for and modeled on him.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Young Matt sobs to Stick that his dad was paid to lose against Creel, but won because Matt wanted him to, and was killed for it. Matt and Creel never meet.
stages.whoA: Crusher Creel. The boxer Matt's dad was paid to lose to, then beat.
stages.whoB: Matt Murdock. Son of the boxer who refused to lose to Creel.

stages.title: Thunderbolts*
stages.text: Fourteen months after her team is named the New Avengers, Sam Wilson is fighting them over the Avengers name. Yelena grumbles that he does not understand the government made them the Avengers, and asks Bucky whether he talked to him. Sam himself never appears.
stages.whoA: Sam Wilson. He is fighting her New Avengers over the Avengers name.
stages.whoB: Yelena Belova. Her New Avengers are fighting him over the Avengers name.

stages.title: Thunderbolts*
stages.text: Facing impeachment, Valentina reminds Congress that the last president turned into a bright red monster who nearly destroyed the city, and uses it to argue for her own protectors. She never names Ross, and they are never seen together.
stages.whoA: Thaddeus Ross. The last president; she cites his Red Hulk rampage to Congress.
stages.whoB: Valentina Allegra de Fontaine. She cites his Red Hulk rampage to save herself.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Attorney General Steverud resists Mayor Fisk's plans against vigilantes until he takes a phone call from Miss de Fontaine, then promises Fisk his office's full support. Fisk and Valentina are never seen together.
stages.whoA: Valentina Allegra de Fontaine. Her call wins him the Attorney General's support.
stages.whoB: Wilson Fisk. The mayor she pushes the Attorney General to back.

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: Raza, the old Ten Rings leader, arrives with an armed team to collect a bounty and demands that Paladin hand over Vision alive. His men attack, and a gunfight follows.
stages.whoA: Raza. The old Ten Rings leader who comes to claim the bounty on Vision.
stages.whoB: Vision. The bounty Raza comes to collect, alive.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: In 1989, the agents freeing the aged Werner Reinhardt, later Whitehall, say Undersecretary Pierce took pity on him, then say Hail Hydra. The team later learns Pierce granted him medical parole. They are never seen together.
stages.whoA: Alexander Pierce. The Hydra undersecretary who set him free on parole.
stages.whoB: Daniel Whitehall, once Werner Reinhardt. Pierce granted him parole.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Lorelei taunts Sif that she will never have Thor, a man who sees her as more pet than woman. It is only talk; Thor never appears.
stages.whoA: Thor. She taunts Sif that he sees her as more pet than woman.
stages.whoB: Lorelei. An escaped Asgardian prisoner who mocks Sif over him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Lorelei has spent six hundred years locked in an Asgardian cell. After her escape, Sif tells Coulson that Odin ordered her brought back alive. Odin never appears.
stages.whoA: Odin. The king who orders her brought back alive to the dungeons.
stages.whoB: Lorelei. An escaped prisoner he orders brought back alive.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Bobbi identifies the attacker at the UN as Marcus Scarlotti, the assassin who almost killed Barton a few years back. It is only mentioned; Clint never appears.
stages.whoA: Clint Barton. A fellow agent Scarlotti almost killed, as she recalls.
stages.whoB: Bobbi Morse. A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who knows of Scarlotti's attempt on him.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Gilgamesh says Odin gave him his secret brew recipe as thanks after the Eternals helped defeat Laufey's army at Tønsberg. He fought Laufey's army, not Laufey himself, and it is only told.
stages.whoA: Laufey. The Eternals helped defeat his army at Tønsberg.
stages.whoB: Gilgamesh. An Eternal who helped Asgard defeat his army at Tønsberg.
